jobs.name: empty-slot-ivory
jobs.prompt: A production-ready 2D game UI glyph for an elegant musical theater game, matte warm ivory with a very subtle brass highlight, perfectly crisp restrained flat painted shape. PURE BLACK background for later alpha extraction. Entire glyph centered with generous 12 percent padding. No text, no labels, no watermark, no neon, no background panel, no decorative flourishes. Use reference ONLY to match thin ring stroke thickness and circular geometry. Produce EXACTLY ONE EMPTY CIRCULAR SLOT BORDER, uniform WARM IVORY / OFF-WHITE #EEE8D8. Main stroke width is exactly 2 percent of circle outer diameter, the same delicate weight as reference rings (about 1.3 px at 68px display). Circle interior and outside PURE BLACK. Perfect smooth single continuous circular outline. Absolutely NO patterns, NO musical curls, NO ornaments, NO dot markers, NO double rings, NO bevel, NO glow, NO filled disk. Solid pale ivory, no colored blue gold red sections.

jobs.name: sort-recycle
jobs.prompt: A production-ready 2D game UI glyph for an elegant musical theater game, matte warm ivory with a very subtle brass highlight, perfectly crisp restrained flat painted shape. PURE BLACK background for later alpha extraction. Entire glyph centered with generous 12 percent padding. No text, no labels, no watermark, no neon, no background panel, no decorative flourishes. It must read as a circular recycling / refresh symbol, NOT a triangle. All arrows same balanced width, large empty black circular center. Simple flat warm ivory strokes with a very restrained gold edge light. No music notes, no staff, no list, no external circle, no button frame. Strong silhouette readable at 32px.
